_comment: Web 版新增的文案。Godot 源项目里没有这些 key——它们的成功/失败面板是 _draw() 画出来的，文案直接写在代码里，源项目从来没把它们收进文案表。移植到 DOM/Canvas UI 之后，面板上的字必须走 i18n，所以在这里补齐。合并发生在 tools/extract-data.mjs。**除下面列出的覆盖项外只增不改**：原有 key 一个都不动，两侧集合严格一致这条断言才守得住。
_override:
少数 key 在这里是**覆盖**源项目的值。合并是 `{...源, ...本表}`，写在后面就赢，而覆盖项**只写英文侧**（中文侧继续用源表原文，所以本表天然允许不对称——`prologue_speaker` / `player_speaker` / `language` 三个既有项也是这样）。现有四组：
(1) quality_hint_low / _medium / _high —— 源文案 quality_hint 还在讲草皮几何体，而那一层已整层删除（settings.ts 里换成了 groundDetail），源文案的 70m 两边都不对。更要紧的是它只有一句、恒定描述低档，玩家选了高档仍然读到低档的说明，所以拆成三条按档位取；
(2) prologue_speaker / player_speaker —— 英文名对外统一用 Miles Lu，与 promo/ 宣传物一致，避免商店页和游戏里主角叫两个名字；
(3) 四个核心资源的英文名（lvbi_label / collecting_lvbi / shop_balance / shop_need_lvbi / mood_label / shop_mood_full / fragments / fragment_obtained / shop_need_frags / stations_seen 等）—— **源项目的英文直译在界面上读不通**：
    · 旅币 译成 Lvbi（拼音），英文玩家读不出它是什么，而引导页 glossary_lvbi 教的是 Coins；
    · 心神 —— 源项目里 glossary_mood 译成 Heart、mood_label 译成 Composure，**同一个词两种译法**。
      早先的做法是把 mood_label 改成 Heart 去迁就引导页（`verify_i18n_glossary` 守的是
      「引导页教的词 == HUD 用的 label」），但 Heart 是个会被**消耗**的资源：
      收一块碎片掉一格，叫 Heart 会让人本能地以为要「攒」。
      商店里清心茶的描述（shops.json 的 desc_en）一直写的是 Composure，三处本来就对不齐。
      现在**统一成 Composure**：引导页、HUD、商店三处同名，判据 `verify_i18n_glossary` 仍然成立，
      而且 Composure 自带「镇定 / 撑住」的意思，和掉一格就起雾的机制对得上；
    · 碎片 在同一个面板里同时出现 Fragments（表头）和 Shards（计数）；
    判据是 `verify_i18n_glossary`：**引导页教的词与 HUD 用的 label 必须是同一个名词**。
    旅币按项目要求统一用 Coin（不用拼音）。
(3b) 标题页的画质组默认折叠（`fold_open` / `fold_close`），演示按钮在自行车模型到货前
    显示 `demo_loading` / `demo_loading_hint` 并禁用——见 titleScreen.ts 的 `demoReady`。
    加这一组是因为折叠线本身要有一行可点的标题，而「演示等车」必须写在界面上：
    静默降级成徒步的那个 90 秒，是这个游戏作为「骑行游戏」的第一句话。
(4) 驿 的英文一律 Station —— 源项目译作 Post，
    而 post 在英文里读作邮件或职位，不读作驿站。涉及：
    stations_seen / finish_run_hint / revisit_available / synthesis_choice_hint / synthesis_done_message / shop_locked / voice_speaker / home_speaker / back_keep / prologue_0_3 / prologue_1 / objective_return / hud_home_target / touch_home_button / desktop_home_prompt / objective_overdue
    十八驿温泉旅驿 对外是 The Eighteenth Station inn。

zh.quality_hint_low: 最低的一档：阴影与地面细节全关，行道树收到 95m、灌木 40m，雾也拉近 · 植被范围重新进这一趟生效
zh.quality_hint_medium: 中间的一档：阴影 1024px、地面细节铺到 34m，行道树 150m、灌木 80m · 植被范围重新进这一趟生效
zh.quality_hint_high: 最高的一档：全分辨率、阴影 2048px、地面细节铺到 58m，行道树 220m、灌木 140m · 植被范围重新进这一趟生效
zh.postcard_origin: 十八驿的物件。这条路上散着五件前人的乐事——云、茶、琴、竹、禽。到一处坐下来待一会儿，卡上那一格才落得成真；五格齐了，才是一张完整的卡。背面那句话，由你写。
zh.postcard_look_hint: 点一件碎片，看它落在卡上的哪儿、还差几次
zh.key_camera_desc: 切换视角（向前 / 追车 / 骑手）
zh.key_vehicle_desc: 换载具（徒步 / 自行车 / 摩托车 / 滑板）
zh.hint_ring_needed: 再靠近一点 · 站进光圈再按空格
zh.help_overlay:
W / ↑　加速前进
S / ↓　减速 · 倒车
A / ←　左转　　D / →　右转
空格 / 回车　靠近驿站时打卡
Esc　暂停 · 继续
M　静音
V　切换视角（向前 / 追车 / 骑手）
E　换载具（徒步 / 自行车 / 摩托车 / 滑板）
1 ~ 4　选道具
zh.mg_success_hint: 这一刻收下了 · 驿站上的圆点亮了一格
zh.perf_note: 卡的话把渲染分辨率调低一档 —— 它只改内部采样，画面元素一个都不动。
zh.adaptive_hint: 帧率低于目标时自动降内部渲染分辨率。只降不升，避免画面呼吸。
zh.unsupported_body: 这个游戏需要 WebGL 2。你现在的浏览器没有可用的 WebGL 2 上下文。
zh.unsupported_fix: 可以试：换用较新的 Chrome / Edge / Firefox；在浏览器设置里打开「使用硬件加速」；或换一台带独显的电脑。
zh.touch_why: 摇杆 / 打卡 / 暂停。手机上会自动打开，桌面上也可以手动开。
zh.objective_return: 五件乐事都齐了。回十八驿去。
zh.home_arrive_3: 五件乐事都在这儿了。这一章到这儿。
zh.chapter1_done_line: 188 号环线，一趟。这一趟到此为止——第二章在路上。
zh.synthesis_home_hint: 第一章完成了。收下这份礼物，或者再骑一圈。
zh.fatal_note: 这一屏是故意留下的——把上面那行字连同浏览器控制台一起反馈，就能定位到具体哪一步。
zh.cap_reason_no_webgl2: 这台浏览器没有可用的 WebGL2
zh.cap_reason_software: 显卡在用软件渲染（没开硬件加速）——画质已压到最低，能跑但会慢
zh.cap_reason_unknown_gpu: 未识别显卡，按中档起步
zh.cap_reason_no_gpu: 浏览器未提供显卡型号，按中档起步
zh.key_relic_desc: 摸路边的旧物 · 竹丛里按节拍
zh.relic_near: 路边有东西被留在这儿。
zh.relic_bowl_text:
指腹压过碗底那道磨痕。
六百年前有人在这儿摔过它，又一片片捡起来粘好。
……补得比我笨。
zh.relic_ring_text:
铜的，磨得只剩一层皮。
六百年里被推过多少次，我数不清。
最后推它的那个，是我妈。
zh.relic_ledger_text:
最后一页是今年的。
客人的名字都还挂着，房钱那一栏空着。
……她走的那天，账就停在这一页。
zh.relic_shoe_text:
鞋底磨穿了，鞋帮上绣着半个「路」。
另一只大概在回去的路上。
它讲不了什么，只是走累了。
zh.relic_key_text:
铜的，还带着锈。
它说：我最后一次开门，是替你妈把门关上的。
……摸到它的时候，我的手在抖。
zh.objective_collect: 五件乐事散在这条路上。
zh.objective_overdue: 期限过了。回十八驿把话说完。
zh.objective_chapter2: 把路上的旧物都听完，还剩 %d 件。
zh.ending_overdue_full: 三十日已经到了。这一趟五座都走满了——拿得越满，到期得越干净。
zh.beat_done: 竹：一段路，五个节拍，一口气骑完。
zh.cap_reason_restored: 沿用你上次选的画质档（本次探测：%s）
zh.demo_loading_hint: 自行车还在路上——到货就能看这一趟
zh.save_migrated_line: 这一版存档格式变了，旧进度没能带过来。重新开始一次。
zh.save_unsaved_line: 浏览器拒绝写入本地存储（隐私模式或空间已满）。这一趟不会留下存档。
zh.tea_pour_text: 壶嘴一斜，水就进了盏里。他站着听了一会儿——原来「忙完了」是有声音的：一声，很轻，之后什么都没有。
zh.mg_cloud_hint_touch: 用一根手指沿着虚线拖过去 · 描满 75% 就算成
zh.mg_bamboo_title: 竹子长过头了，把庭里的灯挡死了。挥刀砍开一条道！
zh.mg_bamboo_intro: 拖动屏幕挥刀 · ← → 移刀位、空格挥刀 · 竹刺砍到掉一命 · ESC 放弃
zh.challenge_sign_text: 半截木板钉在路肩上，炭写的字被人用手指描过一遍：「这一圈路上有人撒了石头。能一件不碰地绕回这块木牌的人，碎片归他。碰了不算——石头还在原地，你随时可以再来一圈。」
zh.challenge_hint: 这里钉着一块木牌 · 按 F 读它
zh.challenge_start_text: 石头已经摆上路了。从木牌这里起算——绕回木牌，一件没碰就算数。条上那个数是「还剩多少米」，不是快慢。
zh.challenge_hit_text: 石头把车弹了一下。人没事，路上也没有别的安排——只是这一趟不算。石头还在原地，你随时可以从木牌那儿再来一圈。
zh.challenge_win_text: 绕回木牌的时候，路面上一个轮胎印也没有——那些石头从刚才起就一直摆在那儿，只是你一件都没碰上。碎片自己落进你手里：{name}。
zh.qin_intro_text: 林子里没有舞台，只有一张石台和一张旧琴。它只有七根弦，可弹起来够三个八度——谁都可以坐下来弹一会儿，弹多久都行，弹错了也不会有人记你。这一件不算乐事：不给旅币，不点亮任何东西。
zh.qin_hint: 数字键 1-7 上八度 · Q W E R T Y U 中八度 · Z X C V B N M 下八度 · 触屏直接点弦 · ESC 离开
zh.qin_hint_near: 琴音林里有张琴 · 按 F 坐下来弹一会儿
zh.challenge_all_full_text: 绕回木牌，还是一件都没碰。只是五座驿站都被你走满三遍了，这一圈换不来新的碎片——石头还在原处，你想再绕几圈都行。
zh.lakeside_enter: 湖边 · 按 F 走过去
zh.lake_strike: 咬钩了 —— 现在按 空格！
zh.lake_hold: 按住 空格 收线 · 松开让鱼缓口气
zh.lake_vr_failed: 这台机器没能开起 VR 会话。
zh.nothing_here: 这里没有能进的地方 —— 驿站在半圈亮着的那条里。
zh.relic_bowl_past:
它记得那一下。
不是摔，是磕在门槛上——那天风大，有人一手端着满碗，一手去扶门框。
后来他把碗沿磨圆了。不是为了好看，是为了下次再磕的时候不割手。
zh.relic_ring_past:
它记得的门比我记得的多。
有一年冬天，它被摘下来当了三个月的钥匙。驿站没有客人，守夜人把它摘下来，说这样门就不是门，是个念想。
后来又装回去了。
zh.relic_ledger_past:
它记得那些空格。
前面几十页，每一行都填到底：名字、房钱、走没走。
后面几十页，名字还在，房钱那一栏全是空的。
不是没住过——是没有人再来记账了。
zh.relic_shoe_past:
它不记得主人。
它只记得走路：左脚落地重，右脚落地轻，中间缺了一步——那一段没有地面，那个人是被抬过去的。
到这儿它就没再往前。
zh.relic_key_past:
它记得上一次开门是什么时候。
那天之后它就一直开着，谁也没去关——门环上那层锈就是从那时候开始长的。
后来是他们替我关的。
zh.relic_bowl_echo:
回去的路上，我在水洼里看见一只一样的碗。
它不是我的。
zh.relic_ring_echo: 十八驿的门环，今天不用推就开了。
zh.relic_ledger_echo: 账本摊开在柜台上，风把它翻到了空的那一页。
zh.relic_shoe_echo:
路肩上多了一双鞋。
两只。
zh.relic_key_echo:
温泉那边的门开着。
已经开了很多年。
zh.relic_teapot_text:
壶嘴有一道豁，用锡补过，补得很难看。
这是爷爷的——不是外婆的，不是妈的。
我上一次看见它，它在柜子最上层，落着灰。
zh.relic_teapot_past:
它记得的不是上一次喝茶。
它记得有人对着它说过一句：「等你回来喝。」
说这句话的人没等到。
zh.relic_teapot_echo:
柜子最上层空了。
而茶还温着。
zh.relic_lamp_text:
它没坏。
这是我在这条路上第一次遇到一件不该由我修的东西——油是满的，灯芯是新的，玻璃擦得很干净。
有人一直在照着它。
zh.relic_lamp_past:
它记得换过几任灯油。
每一任都先把玻璃擦一遍，再续油。
有一任忘了擦。玻璃蒙了一层灰的那三个月，没有人来敲门——他们以为驿站关了。
zh.relic_lamp_echo:
灯还亮着。
比平时亮一点。
zh.relic_chop_text:
刀口朝外插在地上，柄上缠着布。
布是后来缠的——它被用过很多次之后才被这样放好。
插刀的人走得急，没拔。
zh.relic_chop_past:
它记得自己刻过什么。
一块木头，刻了一半的字。剩下的那半不是没刻完，是故意留的。
刻到「驿」字的时候那个人停了手，说：往后再有人来，接着刻。
zh.relic_chop_echo:
路边那块木头还在。
上面多了一个字。
zh.chapter2_door_text:
你本可以把它卖掉。
你没有——于是山上还有八件东西在等着被摸一遍，其中三件你从来没听说过。
zh.epilogue_keep:
多年以后，一个孩子在别人家柜子最上层摸到一把茶壶。
他把那道锡补的豁口摸了三遍。
没有人告诉他那是谁的——但他把它放回去的时候，用的是他爷爷教他的手法。
zh.epilogue_let_go:
很多年以后，这条路上还留着几件没人认领的东西。
守着它们的人换了几个，待得最久的那位等了六百年。
它们还在等下一个人停下来。
zh.ending_sub_keep: 门留着。下一趟路过的人，推得开。
zh.accessibility_why:
这些设置存在你的机器上，换一次游戏仍然有效。
音量与静音、配色、动效、键位——每一样都会立刻生效。
zh.key_conflict:
「%s」已经绑在「%s」上了。
换一个键，或者先改那边。

en.desktop_home_prompt: Space · Head back to the Station
en.hint_ring_needed: Move closer · step into the glowing ring, then press Space

W / ↑　speed up

A / ←　left　　D / →　right

en.mg_success_hint: Taken. One more light on the station.

en.touch_why: Joystick / check-in / pause. Turns on automatically on phones; you can also force it on a desktop.
en.objective_return: All five joys are gathered. Head back to the Eighteenth Station.
en.home_arrive_3: The five joys are all here. This chapter ends here.
en.chapter1_done_line: The 188 loop, once through. This stretch ends here — the next chapter is on the road.
en.synthesis_home_hint: Chapter one is done. Take the gift, or ride one more lap.
en.fatal_note: This screen is here on purpose — send the line above along with your browser console and we can pin down which step failed.
en.cap_reason_no_webgl2: No usable WebGL2 in this browser

en.key_relic_desc: Feel an old thing by the road · tap the beat in the bamboo
en.relic_near: Someone left something by the road.
en.relic_bowl_text:
My thumb finds the worn mark on its base.
Six hundred years ago someone dropped it here, and picked it up piece by piece.
...They glued it back worse than I would have.
en.relic_ring_text:
Bronze, worn down to a skin.
I cannot count how many times it was pushed in six hundred years.
The last one to push it was my mother.
en.relic_ledger_text:
The last page is from this year.
The guests are all still listed. The rent column is blank.
...The account stopped on the day she left.
en.relic_shoe_text:
The sole is worn through. Half a character for "road" is embroidered on the side.
The other one is probably on the way back.
It has nothing to tell me. It is just tired.
en.relic_key_text:
Bronze, still rusted.
It says: the last time I was turned, I was your mother shutting the door behind her.
...My hand was shaking when I felt it.
en.objective_collect: The five joys are scattered along this road.
en.objective_overdue: The deadline has passed. Go back to the Eighteenth Station and finish the conversation.
en.objective_chapter2: Listen to everything left on the road — %d still to go.
en.ending_overdue_full: The thirty days are up. All five stations are full — the fuller this trip got, the cleaner it expired.
en.beat_done: Bamboo: one stretch of road, five beats, ridden without stopping.
en.glossary_mood_desc: Each fragment costs one. The lower it drops, the thicker the fog.
en.finish_run_hint: Not every station walked yet — this one is rated on what you did ride.
en.revisit_available: The pips in the top bar are still open — two more visits to every station.
en.synthesis_choice_hint: One loop is a whole run: five joys, five characters, one postcard. For the full rating, two more visits to every station.
en.synthesis_done_message: Every station walked three times over. The gift is forming...
en.back_keep: The Eighteenth Station inn is still here with me. If you are lost, knock.
en.prologue_0_3:
There is one more thing I have told no one.
The family business — the Eighteenth Station inn — my mother left it to me the year she disappeared.
It is not an inheritance. It is a sentence she never finished saying.

When you left, the mountains were still here, Mother.
en.prologue_1:
The lawyer's letter arrived.
The Eighteenth Station has lain idle for six years. Open it within thirty days, or the land is taken by law.

I'll go back and take a look.
en.cap_reason_restored: Keeping your saved quality — this machine reports %s
en.demo_loading_hint: The bicycle is still on its way — the demo starts the moment it lands.
en.save_migrated_line: The save format changed, so the old progress could not be carried over. This run starts again.
en.save_unsaved_line: The browser refused local storage (private mode, or no space left). This run will not leave a save.
en.mg_tea_pour_line: The water is full. Time to pour a cup.
en.tea_pour_text: The spout tilts and the water goes into the cup. He stands there listening for a while — so "done" does have a sound to it. One, very quiet, and then nothing after it.
en.mg_cloud_hint_touch: Drag along the dotted line with one finger · 75% counts as done
en.mg_bamboo_title: The bamboo has grown over the courtyard and blocked the lamp — swipe to cut a path open!
en.mg_bamboo_intro: Drag to slash · ← → to aim, SPACE to chop · burrs cost a life · ESC to give up
en.mg_bamboo_burr: Burr! Do not cut that one
en.challenge_sign_text: A half-board is nailed to the shoulder, and someone has traced over the charcoal words once: "Somebody scattered stones around this loop. Whoever gets back to this board without touching one of them, a fragment is theirs. Touch one and it does not count — the stones stay where they are, and you can start another lap whenever you like."
en.challenge_hint: There is a board nailed here · press F to read it
en.challenge_start_text: The stones are on the road now. You start counting from the board — get back to it without touching one and it counts. The number on the bar is how many metres are left, not how fast you are going.
en.challenge_hit_text: A stone knocks the bike aside. Nothing hurts and nothing else on the road has changed — this lap just does not count. The stones are still there, and you can go again from the board whenever you like.
en.challenge_busy: You are already on a lap
en.challenge_win_text: Back at the board, and not a single tyre mark on the stones — they were standing there the whole time, and you touched none of them. A fragment drops into your hands on its own: {name}.
en.qin_intro_text: There is no stage in the grove, only a stone table and an old qin. It has seven strings and they cover three octaves — anyone may sit down and play for a while, for as long as they like, and nobody keeps a record of what they get wrong. This is not one of the five pleasures: no coins, nothing lit up.
en.qin_hint: 1-7 top octave · Q W E R T Y U middle · Z X C V B N M low · tap a string on touch · ESC to leave
en.qin_hint_near: There is a qin in the grove · press F to sit and play for a while
en.qin_left: The grove keeps the sound for a while
en.challenge_all_full_text: Back at the board, still having touched nothing. It simply is that all five stations have now been ridden three times over, and this lap has nothing left to hand over — the stones are where they were, and you can go round as many more times as you like.
en.lakeside_enter: Lakeside · press F to step in
en.lake_missing: That shore could not be loaded.
en.lake_hold: Hold Space to reel · release to let it rest
en.lake_vr_failed: This machine could not open a VR session.
en.nothing_here: Nothing to enter here — the post is inside the ring that lights up.
en.relic_bowl_past:
It remembers the drop.
Not a fall — it caught the threshold. The wind was up, and someone carried a full bowl in one hand and reached for the door frame with the other.
He ground the rim smooth afterwards. Not to make it prettier. So that the next time it caught, it would not cut anyone.
en.relic_ring_past:
It remembers more doors than I do.
One winter it was taken down and used as a key for three months. The station had no guests, so the night watch removed it and said: this way it is not a door any more, it is something you think about.
Then it was put back.
en.relic_ledger_past:
It remembers the blank column.
For the first few dozen pages, every line was filled in: name, rent, departed or not.
For the dozens after, the names are still there and the rent column is empty.
Nobody stopped staying. The station simply stopped writing it down.
en.relic_shoe_past:
It does not remember who wore it.
It only remembers walking: the left foot lands heavy, the right lands light, and between them a step is missing — no ground there. That was the stretch they carried him across.
It did not go any further.
en.relic_key_past:
It remembers the last time it was opened.
It has been open ever since. Nobody went back to shut it — that is when the green began growing on the ring.
In the end, they shut it for me.
en.relic_bowl_echo:
On the way back I saw the same bowl in a puddle.
It was not mine.
en.relic_ring_echo: The ring on the Eighteenth Station's door opened without a push today.
en.relic_ledger_echo: The ledger lies open on the counter. The wind turned it to the blank page.
en.relic_shoe_echo:
There is a pair of shoes on the shoulder now.
Both of them.
en.relic_key_echo:
The door by the spring is open.
It has been open a long time.
en.relic_teapot_text:
The spout has a chip, patched with tin, badly.
This one is Grandfather's — not Grandma's, not my mother's.
The last time I saw it, it was on the top shelf of a cabinet, under dust.
en.relic_teapot_past:
It does not remember the last time anyone drank from it.
It remembers someone saying to it: "When you come back, I will pour."
That person did not wait.
en.relic_teapot_echo:
The top shelf is empty.
And the tea is still warm.
en.relic_lamp_text:
It is not broken.
This is the first thing on this road that is not mine to fix — the oil is full, the wick is new, the glass has been cleaned.
Somebody has been tending it.
en.relic_lamp_past:
It remembers how many people refilled it.
Each of them wiped the glass first, then poured the oil.
One of them forgot. For three months the glass clouded over, and nobody knocked — they thought the station had closed.
en.relic_lamp_echo:
The lamp is still lit.
Brighter than usual.
en.relic_chop_text:
The edge faces out of the ground, cloth wound around the handle.
The cloth came later — it was only put down this way after being used many times.
Whoever planted it left in a hurry and did not pull it back out.
en.relic_chop_past:
It remembers what it was carving.
A block of wood, half a character on it. The rest was not unfinished. It was left on purpose.
At the character for "station" the carver stopped and said: whoever comes next, let them finish it.
en.relic_chop_echo:
The block of wood is still by the road.
There is one more character on it.
en.chapter2_door_text:
You could have sold it.
You did not — so there are eight things left up the mountain waiting to be touched, and three of them you have never heard of.
en.epilogue_keep:
Years later, a child reaches the top shelf of someone else's cabinet and finds a teapot.
He runs his thumb over the tin-patched chip three times.
Nobody tells him whose it was — but he puts it back the way his grandfather taught him.
en.epilogue_let_go:
Many years later there are still a few unclaimed things left on this road.
The ones who keep them have changed hands; the one who stayed longest waited six hundred years.
They are still waiting for the next person to stop.
en.lake_exit_touch: Tap here to go back to the road
en.ending_sub_keep: The door stays. Whoever comes through next can push it open.
en.accessibility_why:
These stay on this machine and survive a restart.
Volume and mute, palette, motion, key bindings — each takes effect immediately.
